sources.title: Artificial intelligence for flood risk management: A comprehensive ...
sources.snippet: This paper seeks to explore the vanguard of flood risk management: the integration of artificial intelligence (AI), with a particular focus on machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) technologies. Legacy flood risk management tools, such as physics-based models, are primarily used in predicting a diverse range of flooding scenarios.
